description: Readwise connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's saved book/article highlights as `readwise:highlight` items in the local index — the highlighted excerpt text, the user's note, the parent book/article id, the location + location type, the color, tags, and the source article URL (for web highlights). Useful for answering reading questions ("what did I highlight about retries?", "find my note on backpressure") without leaving Nimbus. Token API-token auth (`Authorization: Token <token>` — Django-REST-Framework token auth, NOT Bearer). The SaaS host (readwise.io) is fixed. Readwise paginates the `/api/v2/highlights/` endpoint by page number (DRF `{ count, next, previous, results }` envelope, page_size=1000). `highlighted_at` / `updated` are ISO-8601 (converted to epoch-ms on index). Books / documents / daily-review and the Reader v3 API are deferred follow-ups; v1 indexes highlights only.
author: Nimbus
